data.title: If you had invested $1,000 in gold instead of Bitcoin five years ago, here is what each is worth today
data.description: July 2021. Bitcoin was sitting at approximately $34,000, riding the tail end of its institutional adoption wave. Gold was trading near $1,800 per ounce, steady and unglamorous as ever. Two assets. Two completely different investor profiles. Same $1,000. Five years later, here is what that ...
